layout.spacing_system: Generous Spacing (p-6 to p-8 internally for forms/cards, gap-4 to gap-6 for grids)
layout.grid_mode: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4)
layout.container_style: Flat Solid Surfaces, max 8px border-radius, 1px subtle border (border-stone-200), minimal shadows.

components.buttons: Flat, rounded-md, solid bg-emerald-700 text-white for primary. hover:bg-emerald-800 transition-colors.
components.inputs: Shadcn inputs. bg-white, border-stone-200, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 focus:border-transparent. text-sm.
components.tables: Dense, crisp lines. border-b border-stone-100 on rows. hover:bg-stone-50. th: uppercase, text-xs, text-stone-500, tracking-wider.
components.navigation: Sidebar App Shell layout. Left sidebar with bg-stone-900 text-stone-300. Active links text-white bg-stone-800. Main content bg-stone-50.
components.cards: bg-white border border-stone-200 rounded-lg p-6 shadow-sm.

login_background.description: Modern grocery store exterior for login page background

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Avoid light gray on white.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 focus:ring-offset-2)
accessibility.testing: Add data-testid to all key interactions, forms, and navigation (e.g., data-testid='sidebar-nav-vendas', data-testid='submit-login')

motion.hover: Subtle background shifts and slight transform (hover:-translate-y-0.5) on summary metric cards.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a modern, minimalist ERP dashboard for a small grocery store (Sabor & Cia).
Modules required: Cadastros (Clientes, Fornecedores, Produtos, Usuários), Compras, Estoque, Vendas (PDV), Financeiro, Contabilidade, Auditoria/Logs.
Implement a responsive App Shell with a dark sidebar (bg-stone-900) and light main content area (bg-stone-50).
Use Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) colors. Primary interactive elements should be Emerald Green (bg-emerald-700).
Use dense 'Control Room' grid layout for the main dashboard (Vendas overview, Estoque alerts).
Ensure tables are data-dense but readable, using Shadcn components.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements to support automated testing.
No glassmorphism. Keep surfaces flat, crisp, with subtle 1px borders.
Incorporate the provided media images for placeholders where appropriate, such as login screen and product thumbnails.
